data.cultural_impact: The name Garda has been historically associated with a body of water in Ireland, named after the Irish goddess, Gar, a water goddess. It has also been used as a surname among Europeans. Through this, Garda represents protection and connection to nature and the ancient Celtic tradition.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Garda holds deep spiritual significance as it highlights the importance of protection, especially in Christian cultural context. It can serve as a reminder of God’s protection, and also our responsibility to protect and serve those around us in his name. Furthermore, it echoes the biblical belief in God as our protector and the source of true security.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Garda was a 5th century BC Celtic goddess of the waters. The name Garda carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
